title: kate-core: classify a change on disk
summary: note_disk sets FileState::disk_change to Modified, Deleted, or Created. A matching digest clears the flag. from_loaded stays as it is. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. It does not need a window, a file watcher, or the owner's eyes.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add FileState::note_disk. A missing file sets Deleted. The digest is ignored in that case. When the stored change is Deleted and the file exists, set Created. When the file exists and the digest differs from digest_on_disk, set Modified. When the file exists and the digest matches, clear disk_change. Leave from_loaded unchanged. The existing load tests stay green. Leave workspace.rs and modeline.rs unchanged. This packet does not watch the disk. Leave session.rs, lib.rs, and files.rs in kate-ui unchanged. PKT-0051 owns those files. Leave bar.rs unchanged. PKT-0067 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: document::tests::note_disk_names_modified_deleted_and_created
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because note_disk does not exist. A matching digest clears the change. A different digest sets Modified. A missing file sets Deleted. The next existing file sets Created. A second call with the same digest clears Created.
